deployedEdgeDifference: Shared time-based EWMA/window/rate math and immediate physical GPS rule. Deployed localAlert is an uncalibrated local temperature-threshold advisory, with no statistical hysteresis. Evaluation-only edge comparator has held-out cutoff and 2-positive/3-negative hysteresis. Neither changes approved-policy alerts.

protocol.normalHourDefinition: false advisory episode starts (rising edges), divided by normal samples times sampling interval / 3600; includes warm-up; not number of positive samples

timingDefinitions.firstDetectionDelay: seconds from first scenario-injected positive ground-truth sample to first positive detector sample at or after it; null if never detected
timingDefinitions.firstThresholdBreach: seconds from that same injection sample to the first sample outside 2–8°C; threshold is a comparator, not ground truth
timingDefinitions.leadTime: threshold-breach timestamp minus first detector timestamp, only when the detector first alarms no later than the breach; positive means earlier warning

labeling.source: simulator-emitted per-sample groundTruth labels from scenario injection state; independent of 2–8°C policy limits

injectedProfiles.compressor_drift: active from injection including in-range gradual warm-up
injectedProfiles.gps_jump: active on injected outbound jump and following return transition; independent of speed threshold

calibration.training: normal-only detector feature fitting; original noise=1 and 60-second sampling settings

edge.score: max(|30-minute rolling z|/3, |60-second bin rate °C/min|/3, |time EWMA deviation °C|/2.5, flatline seconds/480); physical GPS speed rule bypasses hysteresis

edge.description: held-out-normal-calibrated composite edge score with 2-positive activation / 3-negative clear hysteresis

ai_raw.description: normal-only multifeature AI score before k-of-n persistence

ai_persisted.description: AI flag requiring 2 of the latest 3 raw positive scores

compressorDriftTimingSameRunSet.method: per seed, all three times use the same scenario-injected onset and same run rows

robustness.settings: evaluation only: noise multipliers 1.5 and 2.0 for all five scenarios; 10-second interval for all five; compressor drift slopes 0.09 and 0.36 °C/min. Training/calibration remained at original noise=1, 60-second interval, slope=0.18 °C/min.

limitations: All data and scenario labels are synthetic injections, not independent operational or clinical ground truth.
The temperature threshold cannot detect GPS or sensor-integrity faults unless they also breach temperature limits.
Realistic-prevalence precision/F1/PR-AUC values are mathematically reweighted estimates based on measured sensitivity and false-positive rate, not field prevalence samples.
Edge and AI remain advisory; approved per-batch policy remains authoritative.
